The '''CR-series''' was a family of multipurpose vessels built by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

===Known classes===
*[[Thranta-class corvette|CR-12 Corvette]]
*[[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20 Trooper Carrier]]
*[[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]]
*[[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70 corvette]]
**[[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite]]
*[[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]
*[[CR92a Assassin-class corvette]]

==Behind the scenes==
Fandom often makes efforts to fit various other CEC vessels into this nomenclature, such as the frequent usage of [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20]] to refer to the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]] or [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|CR90a]] to refer to the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]].
